site.name: Alderman Deposit
overview: Alderman Deposit is a federally documented fluorite-bearing mineral deposit in the Browns Canyon district of Chaffee County, developed by historic underground workings.

timeline.text: The Alderman deposit was developed by a crosscut adit and drift as part of mineral exploration and mining activity in the Browns Canyon district.
U.S. Geological Survey Professional Paper 626 documented the Alderman deposit and its underground workings in the Poncha Springs NE quadrangle.

moreHistory: USGS documentation identifies the Alderman deposit as a Browns Canyon fluorite locality and describes a roughly 210-foot crosscut adit reaching a drift about 90 feet long. The report noted that the adit was caved by the time of publication.
A later U.S. Geological Survey mineral-resource compilation retained the Alderman deposit at approximately 38.6253, -106.0661, preserving a stable location for this historic mineral property.
